headline: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said workers' remittances are expected to reach $44 billion this fiscal year, while urging businesses to raise productivity and saying 7-8% growth is not enough without jobs.

card.desc: Aurangzeb says 7-8% growth is not enough without jobs.

caption:
Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said workers' remittances are expected to reach $44 billion this fiscal year, Business Recorder reports. Speaking at LUMS in Lahore, he urged businesses to raise productivity and said 7-8% growth is not enough without jobs, Geo News adds.
